reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 expressly confirms Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, which directly supports the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is unchanged and deterministic checks are clean.

Rationale accurately characterises the pricing provisions (§ 7.1 fixed Fees, § 8.3 renewal uplift cap) as Customer-favourable rather than MFN obligations, consistent with the rule's instruction not to flag Vendor-granted or Customer-benefiting terms.
